deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds a spatial relationship, claiming that the cervix is seen 'alongside' the endocervical canal, which is not stated in the text and converts a pointing gesture into an unverified description.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Histologically, this is the endocervical canal here, and so you're looking at the cervix here.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: and the cervix is seen alongside it
deficiencies.caseForForbidden: The rewrite turns the lecturer's deictic pointing word into a specific spatial description ('alongside it') that the original text does not state.
deficiencies.caseForAllowed: The clause simply attempts to translate the lecturer's demonstrative pointing to separate features on a histological slide into coherent textbook prose.

considerations.sourcePassage: You can see maybe with sharp eyes, you'll see that there's a mitotic cell here and there's one here
considerations.reason: This is a conversational remark pointing out individual example cells on an image slide, while the substantive scientific claim that mitotic cells occur at the basement layer was fully retained.

considerations.sourcePassage: and you'll see this in your practicals
considerations.reason: Although this is a remark about the course/practical sessions, retaining it as textbook prose ('and it will be seen in the practicals') does not introduce any distortion or forbidden change.
